title: Wayfarer Exchange services
acceptance: Preview every quoted condition; commit exact stock and aggregate capacity reservations atomically. Keep consistent arrows, Confirm and Esc through the shared station board.
persistence: Current-format offered quotes, accepted instances, unique consignments, target actors, custody, remaining integrity/time, reservations, outcomes and once-only payment receipts.
contentBoundary: All six service families and their prose, prices and recipes are independently authored here. No external company name, source mission groups, script, artwork or progress alias is loaded.
